Make yourself at home

Explore the room

Drag to orbit, pinch or scroll to zoom. Choose Walk to experience the kitchen at eye level.

Arrange your cabinets

Add an item from the library. Select it, then use Move or Rotate in the room, or enter its position in Selected item.

Make more room

Choose Add wall or Edit walls in the library. Select a wall to set its length, height and thickness, or extend end A or B. Use Top view to arrange walls and cabinets. Wall edits do not move cabinets automatically.

Try a different look

Choose a collection and its available finishes. Countertop selections update the backsplash too.
